requirements.minimum_requirement: Every WL/BL/BR/control/VDD/GND/top-IO sink or source needed by current supported config must have geometry-backed access or a geometry-backed synthesized replacement pin.
requirements.evidence_needed: Pin inventories updated to GEOMETRY_BACKED_PIN with bbox/layer/net ownership.
requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: This does not imply DRC/LVS closure.

requirements.minimum_requirement: Array must be the macro core; row, column, control, dummy, replica, and boundary structures must be placed relative to actual array pitch and edge access windows.
requirements.evidence_needed: Updated floorplan report and region bboxes derived from actual geometry.
requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: This does not imply congestion-free final routing.

requirements.minimum_requirement: WL/BL/BR/control/clk/addr/din/dout/top-IO routes must exist as real GDS geometry between source and target access points.
requirements.evidence_needed: Real geometry inventory with pin-to-pin routes and no contract-only dependencies for required nets.
requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: This does not imply timing closure or global route optimality.

requirements.minimum_requirement: VDD/GND must connect module rails to top-level straps/pins through real taps and vias; no contract-only power stitches may remain.
requirements.evidence_needed: Power continuity inventory with geometry-backed rails, taps, and top power pins.
requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: This does not imply EM/IR signoff.

requirements.minimum_requirement: Net-to-shape evidence must refer to actual GDS shapes, and the repaired top GDS must parse, map, and preserve hierarchy consistently for current supported config.
requirements.evidence_needed: Final geometry-backed audits and parsed GDS comparison.
requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: This does not imply full LVS-clean or DRC-clean status unless separately proven.

requirements.minimum_requirement: The minimum complete-GDS bar is geometry-backed connectivity for the current supported config across signal, power, and top pins.
requirements.evidence_needed: Contract/approximate counts reduced to zero for required complete-GDS claim scope.
requirements.still_not_signoff_boundary: Complete GDS is not equivalent to timing signoff, DRC signoff, or LVS signoff.
